svg.aria-label: Fail-closed pre-push review with a round budget
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Fail-closed pre-push review with a round budget
svg.desc: The pre-push review stops being advisory. `--warn-only` is removed, so `osf review run` now fails a push on a kept must-fix or should-fix finding and on a review that could not run. To keep a broken reviewer from looping forever, a new round budget (`in_sandbox_rounds`, `could_not_run_rounds`, both default 3) is counted in the journal state directory, keyed by worktree, and lets a findings round through once past its limit while a could-not-run streak ends blocked with a message. A credential preflight decides a reviewer with no key and no login file before any worker starts, and the secret scrubber now also reads agent login files. The moon `review` task drops `--warn-only`, passes the work item, and the whole-run timeout default drops to 1800s.
